intent: Distinguish travel preference with a condition, duration units, tour starting place, asking versus reaching/permission, hope versus completion, final destination and fewer-step counts.
picturePurpose: Six changing code-owned diagrams explain conditions, duration, starting role, hope, destination and a clearly fictional step-count comparison. Two evidence tasks retain unanswered inquiries.

transfer.stem: 换成公交车、图书馆和湖边村庄，哪组完整保留了信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
条件允许时，我们更愿意坐公交车旅行。我们希望参观新的图书馆。我们的最终目的地是湖边的一个村庄。
词语提示：library 图书馆；lake 湖。

options.text: We prefer to travel by bus when possible. We hope to visit the new library. Our final destination is a village by the lake.
We always have to travel by bus. We hope to visit the new library. Our final destination is a village by the lake.
We prefer to travel by bus when possible. We have already visited the new library. Our final destination is a village by the lake.
We prefer to travel by bus when possible. We hope to visit the new library. Our starting point is a village by the lake.

answer.display: We prefer to travel by bus when possible. We hope to visit the new library. Our final destination is a village by the lake.
